credits.title: Golmaal
credits.overview: Two ill-fated men desperate to make money kidnaps a wealthy woman's dog and demands a hefty ransom. The plan goes down the drain when they get entangled with the wedding of a Business tycoon. More crony characters with agendas of their own get involved and goofs up the plan further more in this rib tickling entertainer

credits.title: Vowels
credits.overview: A romantic anthology of five love stories exploring different dimensions: Attraction, Emotion, Intimacy, Obsession, and Unconditional love, each reflecting diverse emotional experiences.

credits.title: Sardar
credits.overview: An espionage agent who is branded a traitor returns from exile to take down a dubious water project and safeguard the country.

credits.title: Kasada Thapara
credits.overview: The lives of a few individuals get impacted, both in good and bad ways, by the actions of others who are hardly connected to them.

credits.title: Iru Mugan
credits.overview: A disgraced  RAW agent Akilan (Vikram) is recalled by the agency to track down a crazy scientist and a cross dresser Love (also Vikram), who has discovered a deadly new drug  ‘Speed inhaler’.

credits.title: Oru Naal Iravil
credits.overview: A family man gets stuck inside a building with a prostitute, whom he had solicited. As time goes by, the probability of him being caught red-handed by his family or neighbours keeps increasing.

credits.title: Thoongaavanam
credits.overview: A cop with a connection to the criminal underworld finds his secret life exposed when he and his partner are caught stealing cocaine from a powerful drug dealer, a move that puts his son's life in jeopardy.

credits.title: Trisha Illana Nayanthara
credits.overview: A young man falls in love with his childhood friends only to keep breaking up with them, not realising that he will always end up as a loser.

credits.title: Haridas
credits.overview: Sivadas, a valiant officer, neglects Haridas, his child who has autism, due to his profession. Guilty, he decides to make up for his mistakes and do something for his son.

credits.title: Asal
credits.overview: Two brothers envy their step-brother Shiva as he is their father's favourite. Since their plan to deal in drugs and arms is opposed by Shiva, the two brothers hatch a devious plan to bump him off.

credits.title: Villain
credits.overview: Guru, a bus conductor, steals from the corrupt in order to fund an organization that aids people with disabilities. He also pretends to be his twin, Vishnu, to avoid detection and trial.

credits.title: Anbe Sivam
credits.overview: Anbarasu, young and arrogant, and Nallasivam, damaged - physically but not spiritually - by life, are thrown together by circumstances, and find that they are in some ways bound together by fate.

credits.title: Villain
credits.overview: Shiva, a bus conductor, robs the corrupt in order to fund an organisation that aids those with disabilities. To avoid detection and trial, he pretends to be his twin, who has disabilities.

credits.title: Ramanaa
credits.overview: Ramana decides to abolish corruption once for all with the help of his students who are now working in various government offices.

credits.title: Panchatanthiram
credits.overview: Ram's friends hire Maggie, a call girl, to help him get over his wife, who mistakenly believes him to be a philanderer. However, they get in trouble when Maggie ends up dead.

credits.title: Pammal K. Sambandam
credits.overview: Sambandam, A movie stuntman is against the principle of marriage. When he  gets hurt, Dr Janaki performs a surgery in order to heal him. However, during the surgery, Janaki accidentally leaves her wrist watch in Sambandham's stomach. To cover up for the blunder she pretends that she's in love with Sambhandam.
